title: For Hell's Sake
description:
For Hell's Sake is a fast-paced 2D platform game where you play as a demon on a mission to break an old contract.

Constantly hunted by a superior entity, you will have to move forward. Use your fluid and fast movements to cross the world and avoid the traps it contains.

You are going to die. A lot. For sure. But fear not, the Underworld is still with you. Place limited portals wherever you want in order to reappear there in the event of a problem. Be careful not to overdo it and place them with discernment.

You are being hunted. DON'T GET CAUGHT. Or the portals of Hell will no longer be able to do anything for you..

• An original checkpoint management mechanic
• A challenging difficulty
• Fluid and aerial movement
• Four levels of difficulty
• Several skins to unlock while playing
• A leaderboard system personal
description_short: For Hell's Sake is a fast-paced 2D platform game where you play as a demon on a mission to break an old contract. Constantly hunted by a superior entity, you will have to move forward. Avoid the traps scattered around the world. Don't get caught. Don't die.
